evidence.decision: Distinguishes watch app rotation from reserved system press actions and system-owned Vision Pro Crown behavior, then chooses a visible rotation effect and suitable speed/precision.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a context-to-rotation mapping, rate/detent policy and equivalent touch route instead of an undifferentiated Crown interaction recommendation.
evidence.transformation: The altitude-history example separates main-page scrolling from explicit day adjustment, removing the ambiguous simultaneous day-change and scroll mapping.
evidence.verification: Checks unrelated state changes, invisible rotation results, unsuitable precision and reserved press assignments; physical detents and haptic feel remain hardware evidence.
evidence.applicability: Keeps Watch app navigation priority and touch alternatives distinct from visionOS volume, immersion and recentering system functions.
evidence.handoffs: Routes Watch-specific context to the watchOS design topic and immersion decisions to Immersive Experiences.
evidence.distinctiveness: The context-bound rotation contract, equivalent touch behavior and exclusion of arbitrary Vision Pro Crown app commands distinguish this procedure from generic gesture guidance.
